# Running a permission check: is this moment mine?

## What this region is

Evaluating permissions on one hydrated record: building the check from a SchemaMap, passing a subject, the walk order and its cycle rules, listing every admission with createRebacPaths, and loading the record's ownership closure with createHydrator so the check sees what it walks.

## What it exists for

- Set up and call the allow/deny check on one record
- Know why a check threw or denied
- Find out which grants or entitlements admitted a check
- Load the record and its parents so a check can walk them
- What the app wires itself around the check

## When this is not your domain

These mention this region's words but belong elsewhere; the answer is no, and the region named answers instead.

- write the rule that lets org admins manage documents → permission-rules
- the account lives in the CRM, reach it from the user → permission-rules
- give this token the user's permissions capped at read → grants-and-entitlements
- may this member hand out manage on the space → grants-and-entitlements
- list every document this user can see in one query → library-scope
